chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from al-Washshāʾ, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī Maryam, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: What do you say regarding the urine of riding animals and their droppings? He said: “As for their urine, wash whatever of it reaches you; and as for their droppings, they are more widespread than that.”

key_terms.أَبْوَالِ: the urines; referring here to the urine of animals
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْ: then wash; an instruction to cleanse what was affected

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the urine and droppings of animals in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the urine and droppings of animals. It indicates that what is affected by their urine should be washed, while their droppings are treated differently in light of their widespread occurrence.
